messages:
maria: quick heads-up — merged PR 6123 (commit ab12ef) about microbatching defaults ~10m ago. staging longseq p95 spiked. seen p95 and memory bump. https://perf.redwood/reports/longseq-2026-03-17

jonathan: ouch. paste the quick numbers and a flamegraph if you have one?

maria: numbers from a 5m sample:
```
p50: 88ms -> 95ms
p95: 110ms -> 420ms
p99: 480ms -> 1.05s
QPS: 240 -> 210
mem delta: +1.5GB
```
flamegraph: https://perf.redwood/artifacts/fg-longseq-1799054321.svg

li: looked at the change — default microbatch size went from 2 -> 6 in ab12ef. that many concurrent KV windows for long contexts increases cache churn and GC pressure. ran a quick microbench locally: 
```
batch=2: p95=116ms, mem=5.8GB
batch=6: p95=418ms, mem=7.4GB
```
matches staging trend.

chris: thanks li. was the batch bump intended to improve short-context throughput? if so we should not change the global default. either canary it for short requests or make routing by seq_len.

maria: opened revert PR: https://git.redwood/pr/6145 (revert ab12ef). need someone with merge perms to lgtm asap or we can push a hotfix to make default workload-aware.

jonathan: I can review + approve the revert. @chris can you give a +1? :eyes:

chris: +1. revert looks straightforward. prefer revert then design a seq_len routing rule.

maria: thanks — tagging infra/devops for a quick staging deploy after merge.

devops-bot: deploy requested: branch=revert/ab12ef -> env=staging by maria at 1799054450
devops-bot: deploy started (staging) — tracking: https://deploys.redwood/1799054450

li: tiny note — if we keep higher microbatch for short contexts we should add a runtime flag and a seq_len cutoff so longseqs get the conservative default.

maria: revert merged and deploy finished at 1799054702. post-deploy quick numbers (10m):
```
p50: 90ms
p95: 112ms
p99: 470ms
QPS: 238
mem delta: ~+0.05GB (back to baseline)
```

jonathan: looks back to normal, great work. I'll attach the flamegraphs and bench outputs to the ticket.

chris: created follow-up task INFRA-1299 to add seq_len routing and a KV stress unit test: https://tasks.redwood/INFRA-1299

maria: will update the microbatching docs about the default and add a note in the upgrade guide. moving to post-mortem later today. thanks everyone for the quick reviews :tada:
